title: issue-pipeline-verdict/v1
description: Tier 3's per-criterion verdict on one pull request of the issue pipeline (.github/workflows/issue-pipeline.yml), posted on the PR as a ```pipeline-verdict fenced block (the last such block from a trusted author counts). `tools/dash-gen issues verdict check` passes only when every checkbox criterion of every issue the PR closes has exactly one entry, every entry is met, and every met entry cites evidence; an issue with no checkbox criteria is unverifiable and never passes. Tier 3 may mark the PR ready and apply agent:done only after the check passes, and the verdict backstop reverts both when it fails. Matching an entry to a criterion ignores case, code and emphasis marks, whitespace runs and trailing punctuation (pipeline_contracts.criterion_key).

issue.description: The issue the criterion belongs to: owner/repo#N, or #N for the PR's own repo.

criterion_text.description: The criterion, copied verbatim from the issue (`tools/dash-gen issues verdict template` prints them).

evidence.description: For met, required: a test id (path/test_x.py::test_y), a run URL, or a line anchor (path#Lx-Ly). Prose is not evidence. May be empty otherwise.

note.description: Optional free text, for example why a criterion is unmet. Not checked.
